title: Heliocentric model
description: Copernicus placed the Sun near the centre of the universe, with the Earth and planets orbiting it.

title: Laws of planetary motion
description: Kepler showed that planets move in elliptical orbits and sweep out equal areas in equal times.

title: Moons of Jupiter
description: Galileo observed four moons orbiting Jupiter, evidence that not everything orbits the Earth.

title: Universal gravitation
description: Newton's Principia described gravity as a force between all masses and explained the orbits of the planets.

title: Electromagnetic induction
description: Faraday found that a changing magnetic field induces an electric current, the principle behind generators.

title: Natural selection
description: Darwin explained how species change over time through natural selection of inherited variation.

title: Laws of inheritance
description: Mendel's pea plant experiments showed that traits are passed on in discrete units, now called genes.

title: Electromagnetic theory of light
description: Maxwell showed that light is an electromagnetic wave travelling at a fixed speed.

title: Periodic table
description: Mendeleev arranged the elements by atomic weight and chemical properties, leaving gaps for undiscovered elements.

title: Rabies vaccine
description: Pasteur and colleagues produced the first vaccine against rabies and used it to save a bitten boy.

title: Polonium and radium
description: The Curies isolated two new elements that emit intense radiation, polonium and radium.

title: Quantum hypothesis
description: Planck proposed that energy is emitted in discrete packets to explain black-body radiation.

title: Special relativity
description: Einstein showed that the laws of physics are the same for all observers moving at constant speed and that the speed of light is constant.

title: Bohr model of the atom
description: Bohr described electrons occupying fixed energy levels around the nucleus.

title: Penicillin
description: Fleming noticed that a mould killed bacteria around it, leading to the first antibiotic.

title: Turing machine
description: Turing described an abstract machine that defines what can be computed, the basis of computer science.

title: Transposable elements
description: McClintock found genes in maize that can change position within the genome.

title: Photo 51
description: An X-ray diffraction image of DNA that revealed its helical structure.

title: Parity violation
description: Wu's experiment with cobalt-60 showed that the weak interaction does not conserve parity.

title: Artemisinin
description: Tu Youyou's team isolated artemisinin, a highly effective treatment for malaria.

title: Hawking radiation
description: Hawking predicted that black holes emit radiation because of quantum effects near the event horizon.
